description: Query cross-exchange spot prices (Coinbase + Binance) for major crypto pairs with deterministic positive-price invariant verification and signed attestation (10 free trials/day, then $0.01 USDC). Returns priceUsd, source, invariantCheck ('PASSED'), and execution receipt. Use this whenever a verified non-hallucinated crypto spot price feed is needed.

pair.description: Asset ticker or pair such as 'ETH/USDC', 'BTC/USDC', 'SOL/USDC', or 'ETH-USD'

name: nullclear_fetch_spot_price
